summary.text: Michael Gist, a no-party-affiliation Marine Corps veteran and former public-school teacher, was a candidate in the November 3, 2026 election for Florida's 6th Congressional District, which Randy Fine won.
He describes himself as a lifelong Volusia County resident.
Ballotpedia lists him as having withdrawn while remaining on the ballot.

paragraphs.text: Gist describes his family as lifelong residents of Volusia County for over 100 years, and says his grandmother returned to Ormond Beach after working in New York in 1939.

According to Ballotpedia, he earned a high school diploma from Seabreeze High School, a graduate degree from National University (2002), a military citation from the Naval War College (2005), and a graduate degree from the University of Florida (2018). He says he served 14 years in the U.S. Marine Corps and later taught in Volusia County public schools.

Gist ran as a self-described conservative Independent. According to his survey, his signature proposal, Freedom Accounts, was to redirect government spending into personal investment accounts. Ballotpedia lists him as having withdrawn but still on the ballot.
Randy Fine won the election, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
